domain.description: Domain name to scan (one per line is supported via template multiline handling).

fuzzers.description: List of fuzzing algorithms to use (e.g., 'homoglyph', 'hyphenation'). Must be valid fuzzers from the tool's implementation.

dictionary_file.description: Path to file containing dictionary words for additional domain permutations.

tld_file.description: Path to file containing TLDs to generate additional domain variants.

format.description: Output format: cli, csv, list, json.

output_file.description: Path to file where output should be saved.

nameservers.description: List of DNS or DoH servers to query (comma-separated in rendered config).

threads.description: Number of concurrent threads to use.

banners.description: Determine HTTP and SMTP service banners.

phash.description: Render web pages and compute perceptual hashes for visual similarity.

phash_url.description: Override URL to render for phash comparison.

screenshots_dir.description: Directory to save web page screenshots.

lsh.description: Use fuzzy hashing for web page similarity: ssdeep (default) or tlsh.

lsh_url.description: Override URL to fetch for LSH comparison.

user_agent.description: Custom User-Agent string (default: Mozilla/5.0 (platform arch) dnstwist/version).

geoip.description: Perform GeoIP location lookup for responding IP addresses.

whois.description: Lookup WHOIS database for creation date and registrar.

mxcheck.description: Check if MX host can intercept e-mails.

all_records.description: Print all DNS records instead of the first ones.
